description: 外部验证 issue export 契约。该导出消费 closure work queue、category runbooks、operator execution packet 和 closure evidence summary，把仍待真实外部执行的 work items 转成可导入 issue tracker 的脱敏执行卡片。该导出不创建真实 issue、不请求网络、不保存凭证或 endpoint、不把 issue ready 等同于 live passed。

executionPolicy.issueGate: blocked until real issues are created by an operator, real external validations are executed, and proof-ref/live-proof gates accept redacted evidence.
executionPolicy.noNetwork: This generator must not call GitHub, production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres, OTel, IdP, SIEM, Vault, developer portal or third-party audit services.
executionPolicy.redaction: Output may contain issue titles, labels, owner/category ids, work item ids, occurrence ids, credential variable names, proof-ref patterns, command templates and hashes only; it must not contain endpoint URLs, credential values, DSNs, webhook secrets, chat ids, payloads, user inputs or production logs.
executionPolicy.sourceBinding: Output must bind to work queue sha256, category runbooks sha256, operator packet sha256, closure evidence summary sha256 and current commit.

trackerPolicy.allowedUse: Operator may copy issueTemplates into a tracker after manual review.

privacyBoundary: Issue export 只保存 category、owner、workItemId、occurrence id、required credential 名称、脱敏命令模板、proof-ref pattern、artifact hash 指令、source hash、失败回滚和关闭条件；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not create issues in GitHub or any external tracker.
Does not execute external live checks.
Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not create accepted proof refs by itself.
Does not replace operator execution packets.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
